title: Claw gripper, 2 fingers

notes.heading: Placements
notes.text: Each part stands by a feature it carries, as claw2_assembly.scad's header records, and the claw's layout along the pivots is claw_params.scad's. The tool interface stack under it, with both XL-320s, is ../900-ToolInterface/tool_assembly.scad's. OPEN, in degrees at the fingers, opens the claw: the drive finger turns +OPEN, the follower −OPEN, and the pinion and the servo's output −3.4 OPEN.

notes.heading: Where the servo and the printed parts disagree
notes.text: The Claw Pinion's spline end stands where steps 36-37 set the Span Driver's, which ../920-ParallelGripper/gripper_assembly.view.json gives: its bore's mouth stands inside the span XL-320's case. The spline's length is assumed (../c102_servo.scad), so this waits on a measurement of a servo.
